newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Elang in focus as Jakarta stocks end up.
newsitem.headline: Elang in focus as Jakarta stocks end up.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended sharply up on Wednesday as the overnight rise on Wall Street and continued buying of secondliner Elang Realty spread good sentiment, brokers said.
The composite index rose 5.21 points, or 0.81 percent, to close at 651.45 points. Advancers led decliners by 90 to 47 with 63 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 433 billion rupiah compared with 378 billion rupiah on Tuesday.
